scope.statement: Token-level market data as aggregated by CoinGecko across the markets it tracks (CoinGecko ID "bitcoin").
No curated DeFiLlama protocol mapping exists for this token, so TVL, fees, and revenue are unavailable by design. This is a coverage limitation, not evidence of zero protocol activity.
No verified DexPaprika address mapping (No canonical Bitcoin-chain DexPaprika token address is configured; bridged BTC wrappers are distinct assets.); DEX metrics are unavailable by design.
